correctness.rationale: TARGET route: reran all three artifacts (all asserts pass) and independently extended them: exhaustive S5 relabel search confirms three rings pairwise non-isomorphic; full 36-product NIM(0,0) holds for E49 branching; FPdim identities and dyslectic FPdim 3 hold; Galois-conjugate boson sets verified ({0} Green/E47, {0,4} E49). Parts (a) census arithmetic, (b) Green/E47 A=1 sieve, and (c) Lagrangian dimension equation conditional on (b) check out. Load-bearing gap: E49 A=1+b existence is shown only via extension modular invariant SZ=ZS/T-compatibility, partial NIM(0,0), FPdim identities, and Evans-Gannon realizability of the abstract near-group (Z3,3) type. No commutativity check (2.20)/(2.22) via R-symbols, no full 4x4 B_A fusion table with associativity, and e49_condensation.py line 64 assert is vacuous (or True); numerical consistency is evidence, not proof of a connected etale structure or its uniqueness. Exhaustion over all 20 NRW rank-6 orbits max-N is asserted by inspection without an enumerating script.

originality.rationale: Fused search (SerpBase/Crossref/OpenAIRE; OpenAlex 429-failed, recorded) plus full-body inspection of the decisive primaries shows the conjunction (three NMF rings plus E49 1+b condensation with rank-4 near-group (Z3,3) module category, dyslectic Vec(Z3), and anisotropic list) is nowhere stated or implied. Kikuchi works are explicitly multiplicity-free (8 MF rings; NMF excluded by theorem scope). NRW supplies the underlying S/T data (orbits 14/15/17) and a Witt-triviality corollary but no NMF etale census. Evans-Gannon supplies only the abstract B_A Grothendieck type. Green supplies only the D2=9 modular data. No broader theorem, dual encoding, table, or database covers the E49 condensation claim.

value.rationale: TARGET-admitted problem audited normally: completing the rank-6 connected-etale census on the complementary non-multiplicity-free side (3 rings) left open by Kikuchi-Kam-Huang is a natural classification boundary motivated before computation. The E49 nontrivial condensation (unique boson 1+b, rank-4 B_A of FPdim (17+3sqrt(21))/2, pointed dyslectic FPdim 3), the Green/E47 complete-anisotropy results, and the no-Lagrangian/nonzero-Witt outcome for all NMF rank-6 B are exact, independently retrievable facts a future researcher could need; not a textbook restatement, parameter variant, tiny gain, or unexplained enumeration.

Kikuchi rank<=9 MF classification (arXiv:2404.16125): body Theorem Table 1 explicitly multiplicity-free scope; NMF rings absent.
Ng-Rowell-Wen modular data up to rank 12 (arXiv:2308.09670): body App F entries 47-50 plus App G orbits 14/15/17 (E47 D2~74.6, E49 D2~100.6, Green D2=9); Sec IX no Witt-trivial UMTC at rank 6.
Green rank-6 Galois group <(012)(345)> (arXiv:1908.07128): body S/T and D2=9 data for ring G; no etale classification.
Evans-Gannon near-group doubles (arXiv:1208.1500): body Table 2/Prop 6 constructs C* categories type Z3+3 (abstract B_A type); no rank-6 NMF condensation.
Gannon exotic quantum subgroups (arXiv:2301.07287): body Main Theorem/Tables on C(g,k) affine VOA extensions; exotic rank-6 data not treated.
AnyonWiki front page plus artifact reruns: MF-only lists; nmf_rings.py, e49_condensation.py, su32_final.py all pass; independent S5 non-isomorphism, 36-product NIM00, Galois boson-set checks pass.
